description: Build the Angular /my-transactions page and wire up all frontend touchpoints. Depends on FEAT-001 (backend endpoint must exist). Add PaymentTransactionItem model and getTransactions() to DodoPaymentsService, create the MyTransactionsComponent, register the route, add 'View My Transactions' links to the failed/cancelled states in payment-success, add a self-service card to the contact page, and add a 'Payment Issues?' link to daily-listings.
steps: 1. In ranker.ui/src/app/core/models/payment.model.ts, append the PaymentTransactionItem interface: `export interface PaymentTransactionItem { id: number; action: string; transactionStatus: string | null; paymentId: string | null; sessionId: string | null; orderId: string | null; amount: number | null; currency: string | null; isSuccess: boolean; errorMessage: string | null; createdAt: string; }`

2. In ranker.ui/src/app/core/services/dodo-payments.service.ts, add import for PaymentTransactionItem from '../models/payment.model'. Add method: `getTransactions(email: string): Observable<PaymentTransactionItem[]> { return this.http.get<PaymentTransactionItem[]>(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/payments/transactions?email=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`); }`

3. Create ranker.ui/src/app/features/my-transactions/my-transactions.component.ts. Standalone component, ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush, implements OnInit. Imports: RouterLink, DatePipe, DecimalPipe, FormsModule. Inject: ActivatedRoute, DodoPaymentsService, SeoService, Title. Signals: email=signal(''), transactions=signal<PaymentTransactionItem[]>([]), loading=signal(false), error=signal<string|null>(null), searched=signal(false). ngOnInit: call seo.updateTags({title:'My Payment Transactions | RankUp', description:'Look up your pending, failed, or cancelled payment attempts by email.', url:'https://rankup.cyou/my-transactions'}), then read queryParamMap for 'email' param — if present set email() and call search(). search() method: if email() is empty set error and return; set loading(true), error(null), searched(false); call dodoPayments.getTransactions(email()).subscribe({ next: (res) => { transactions.set(res); searched.set(true); loading.set(false); }, error: (err) => { error.set(dodoPayments.describeHttpError(err, 'Failed to load transactions.')); loading.set(false); } }). statusLabel(status: string|null): string helper returning human-readable label. statusClass(status: string|null): string helper returning CSS class name ('status--pending', 'status--failed', 'status--cancelled', 'status--unknown').

4. Create ranker.ui/src/app/features/my-transactions/my-transactions.component.html. Structure: outer .transactions-page > .transactions-card. Header with h1 'My Payment Transactions' and subtitle. Email lookup form: input[type=email] bound to email() with (input) event, button 'Look Up' (click)='search()'. Loading spinner (div.spinner class). Error message block. Empty-state block when searched() and transactions().length===0: show message 'No pending or failed transactions found for this email.' and link to /contact. Transaction list: @for over transactions(); each item is a .txn-row showing: status chip with [class]='statusClass(txn.transactionStatus)' and text from statusLabel(), amount formatted as currency, paymentId truncated (first 12 chars + '...' if longer), createdAt date using DatePipe with 'medium' format, errorMessage if present in small muted text. Footer: 'Need help? Contact us' routerLink='/contact'. Use @if/@else control flow syntax (not *ngIf) consistent with the rest of the app.

5. Create ranker.ui/src/app/features/my-transactions/my-transactions.component.scss. Use CSS custom property tokens: --surface-container, --surface-container-low, --border, --border-strong, --text, --text-muted, --accent, --secondary, --radius-md, --radius-lg consistent with contact.component.scss and payment-success.component.scss. Define: .transactions-page (centered max-width 700px, padding), .transactions-card (card surface, padding, border-radius using --radius-lg), form layout, .txn-row (row with flex layout, border-bottom), status chip classes (.status--pending amber, .status--failed red/error color, .status--cancelled and .status--unknown grey/muted), .spinner (reuse same keyframe animation as payment-success.component.scss).

6. In ranker.ui/src/app/app.routes.ts, add after the payment-success route entry: `{ path: 'my-transactions', loadComponent: () => import('./features/my-transactions/my-transactions.component').then((m) => m.MyTransactionsComponent), },`

7. In ranker.ui/src/app/features/payment-success/payment-success.component.html: In the `@else if (status() === 'cancelled')` block, add a third button in .actions: `View My Transactions`. Add identical link in the `@else if (status() === 'failed')` block. Add the same link in the `@else if (error())` block. No TypeScript changes needed (RouterLink already imported, email() signal already exists).

8. In ranker.ui/src/app/features/contact/contact.component.html, add a fifth card inside .contact-grid after the fourth card (Physical & Operating Address): `
receipt_long

Payment Transaction History

Self-Service

Made a payment that didn't go through? Enter the email you used at checkout to view your pending, failed, or cancelled attempts.

manage_searchView My Transactions
`. In ranker.ui/src/app/features/contact/contact.component.ts, add RouterLink to the imports array: `imports: [RouterLink],` and add `import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';` at the top.

9. In ranker.ui/src/app/features/daily-listings/daily-listings.component.html, inside the .header-actions div (which currently contains only the 'Live Leaderboard' anchor), add a second anchor after it: `receipt_longPayment Issues?`. RouterLink is already imported in daily-listings.component.ts.
